inputs: spot cache, notebook-16 frozen models/alerts, notebook-22 window catalogs, notebook-29 results; holdouts and the prospective folder not read

section1.check: pi implied by L equals the notebook-22 share_in on the same minutes
section1.possible_minutes: L_e = min(211, max(0, 240 - (breach - onset) minutes)); L_e = 0 means no pre-onset warning is possible under the 30-240 rule

section2.claim: with conditional performance fixed, a change in pi alone can reverse the ranking (not: equal pi implies equal ranking)
section2.line: standard-AUC difference (GBM - M0) = (1 - pi) * dpre + pi * din with dpre, din fixed at the 24-hour definition; crossover interval from notebook 29

section3.analysis: positives restricted to common events under each definition, negatives unchanged; GBM - M0 differences with the shared block bootstrap
section3.common: an H=240 event and an H=1440 event are the same event if their breaches are within 60 minutes

section4.reading: calibrated if the 95% interval of the rejection rate at alpha = 0.05 covers 0.05; conservative if below; anti-conservative if above
section4.surrogate: M0 score circularly shifted within the evaluation period by at least 30 days (both directions), frozen threshold and calendar scheduler re-run
section4.tests: budget-preserving regime-matched null (notebook 26/31 code), circular >=7d and circular 4h-1d nulls (notebook 16 code)

section5.leave_one_month_out: point estimates with each calendar month removed (month blocks, weight 0)
section5.targets: H=1440 GBM - M0 standard and pre-onset AUC; H=240 M0 in-progress share of excess AUC

section6: independent plain-loop implementation of the price-only event rule compared with the frozen function on synthetic series and boundary cases
status: exploratory; appendix; no confirmatory plan changed
title: Reviewer-requested robustness checks on the development sample (exploratory; appendix)
